|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V8-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-restorefreedomtotheg022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/restorefreedomtothegalaxy.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/restorefreedomtothegalaxy.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Coruscant Celebration”. Text: “If Yavin 4 on table, deploy on table. If you just initiated a Force drain at a battleground system (except a 'liberated' system), may draw destiny. Add 1 for each piloted unique (•) snub fighter present at that system. If total destiny > 5, opponent loses 1 Force and stacks lost card face down there (while that card stacked there, system is 'liberated'). If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile. At each 'liberated' system, your Force drains are +1 and opponent's starships are deploy +1.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 23 March 2022<ref name="img-restorefreedomtotheg422d2ae">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/restorefreedomtothegalaxy.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/422d2ae00c7d5e8b247435ea650a8685714bc358 commit 422d2ae] (23 March 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/restorefreedomtothegalaxy.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
